answer: The oasis assignment is published and knoll records each panel. Shards are assigned from the grove graph, as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so a hostile operator cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 2320 identities would post 1050 proofs and burn roughly 88 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
